content.title: Have tattoos? This Mexican-style chain is offering up to 5 free meals for ink of all kinds
content.text: RetailPublished: Mar. 10, 2026, 11:11 a.m.On Friday, March 13, the "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" BOGO offer returns to the Mexican-style restaurant chain.Courtesy of Chipotle Mexican GrillBy Veronica Nocera | The Oregonian/OregonLiveHere’s one way to celebrate Friday the 13th: A burrito bowl. Better yet, a free burrito bowl. For one hour only on Friday, Chipotle will cut its tattooed customers a sweet (savory?) deal — buy-one-get-one-free entrees, eligible for up to five menu items. The promotion will take place between 3 and 4 p.m. at restaurant locations across the United States and Canada.News tipsBusiness opening or closing in your neighborhood? Email the reporter at vnocera@oregonian.com.The bargain, like all great ideas, is an homage to a meme originated during Maroon 5’s Super Bowl halftime show in 2019, when fans described Adam Levine as “tatted like a Chipotle bag.” But what if you love Chipotle but don’t have any ink? No worries. You still maintain your right to BOGO burritos. Per the fine print: “A tattoo can mean a real tattoo, a temporary tattoo, a drawn-on tattoo, or another creative iteration invoking tattoos, as determined at the sole discretion of restaurant staff,” according to a news release. So grab that Sharpie and get to work. There are 58 Chipotle locations in Oregon — 10 of which are right here in Portland. These 3 Oregon metros have already hit $580-year-old scoop shop once called the world’s best ice cream to debut in this Portland suburbThis is the second time Chipotle has offered a deal like this one. Last June, the promotion earned the Newport Beach-based company its highest-ever sales during non-peak hours, according to the release. This year, the promotion also leans into a popular Friday the 13th tradition where tattoo parlors offer flash sheets of small budget-friendly tattoo designs. The Mexican-style chain has even put together a tattoo pack of its own, in partnership with rapper Swae Lee — but it’s only available at a single Chipotle location in Miami.
